author: Andrew Fisher

checks.name: Full circuit fits both axes at all lap positions in landscape, portrait and ultrawide
Forward-facing chase and car-follow retain the car in frame throughout lap
Driver aims along the forthcoming route and uses a road-level lens
Tour includes every diagnostic lap section and recurring aerial orientation
Camera-only updates preserve simulation, source route and source building rows
Exact building footprints avoid false high lifts from coarse city cells
Expanded footprint clearance avoids a building intersecting the requested camera
Manual selection transitions continuously and finishes after one second
Overview transitions fade before changing distant rigs and interrupted fades do not flash
Overview principal-axis orientation stays fixed while a resized viewport still fits
Paused selection animates camera without stepping the simulation or original frame
Reduced motion settles camera selection immediately and stops an active transition
Context recovery preserves selected view and in-progress camera blend without old caches
Detail, plant, tow, fireworks and diagnostic views delegate to existing camera
Camera reset drops prior-lap anchor and recreates deterministic opening view

scope: CPU camera geometry and lifecycle; actual GPU rendering and motion require browser review
